notes.title: Another Small Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Thanks for all of your feedback, here is an update with some extra stuff for you.
[b]Please make sure to leave a Steam review to help us reach more players![/b]

- Added a map marker structure.
- When just unriding a robot that's on follow, it'll now wait a moment before starting to follow you again.
- Added the attack stat to the robot inventory display.
- Fixed Roxorion has a double critical part on it's head.
- Fixed some building in the forest where the stairs were in the wrong position.

More fixes and improvements coming, keep letting me know what you want changed and improved on our [url=https://discord.gg/f4m8NQ2kP8]Discord[/url] or Steam Discussions and I will keep improving the game as long as it aligns with my vision for it, thank you!

notes.title: Game Is Now Released! (Early Access)
notes.notes:
I'm super excited and nervous to tell you that [b]Karagon is now released[/b]!
[b]You can now purchase it, access the full game, and play with your friends!![/b]
I put everything I can into making this game the best for you, and I hope you enjoy it!

The game is launching in Early Access for a short period - I'm very happy with the current state of the game, but I want to hear your feedback before I officially call it complete!
I will dedicate as much extra time as needed in Early Access to make sure the game is in a good state!

If you are still not sure if to get the game or not, I'm leaving the demo up so you can give it a try before purchasing if you haven't already!

[b]If you buy the game and want to show your support, please review it on Steam![/b]
Reviewing the game as soon as possible helps Steam show us it in more places!

If you want to give your feedback, the best place to do that is on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1818610/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.gg/f4m8NQ2kP8]Discord Server[/url].
I will read everything and make fast changes accordingly! 

I hope you are excited for the game, and for what's next to come from me, it's going to be amazing!

notes.title: Release Date Trailer: 13 Feb & Farming Feature Reveal
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Check out our new trailer showing new footage, including a new feature reveal - farming!
It's also revealing our release date - Karagon will be releasing on [b]February 13th (Monday) (updated)[/b]!
[previewyoutube=y45bm1TwK1k;full][/previewyoutube]
I hope that you're looking forward to our release, I'm super excited to see everyone hop in and enjoy the game! I'm sure you will have a lot of fun!
The game will be releasing in Early Access for a short period of time, however, it is mostly in a completed state, the intention of releasing in Early Access is so I can apply your feedback to the game. While we have had many testers play and enjoy it prior to release, I'm sure that with your help we can make it even better, as we've seen mass community feedback during Early Access for survival games be extremely helpful for improving the final product, which is why I want to make sure we put a few extra months to implementing all of your feedback.
Thanks, Tbjbu2.
